_doc: Project-local SEED of durable owner defaults that pre-fill intake. Read via .claude/forge-bin/forge-prefs.cjs::resolve() — do not change this file's shape without updating that reader's validateEntry(). Every pref is {value, source, confidence, scope}: value is the actual default; source is the shipped document (or the owner's own words, once they said them) that evidences it — never invented; confidence is 'evidenced' or 'inferred'; scope is 'global' or 'domain:<x>'. honesty_core.cannot_override_core:true is the untouchable invariant — no later rule may weaken it, only reinforce it. The global copy (~/.claude/FORGE_OWNER_PROFILE.json) is owner-write-only and layers on top of this file.
_doc_seed: 2026-09-23 (external audit II-D): the distribution used to ship the AUTHOR's own preferences here, each quoted as an owner rule ("source: owner AskUserQuestion answer this session") — applied to users who never answered anything. The nine entries below are now Forge's PRODUCT DEFAULTS: each `source` names the shipped document that defines the behaviour, not a person. `/forge remember <text>` adds your own rules on top (they land in ~/.claude/FORGE_OWNER_PROFILE.json and win over these).

never_auto_push.source: Forge default — .claude/commands/forge.md: push, deploy, spend, DNS, production and outbound sends are hard gates; git push only on an explicit owner instruction

value.ui: match-owner (reply in the language the owner writes)

language.source: Forge default — .claude/skills/forge-core/SKILL.md (v8 owner-memory: language follows the owner's messages; code and docs stay English)

deep_research_first.source: Forge default — .claude/skills/forge-scout/SKILL.md: research tasks start from sources, never from memory alone

real_file_testing_for_correctness_critic.source: Forge honesty core — CLAUDE.md 'Honesty (REQUIRED)': never claim a check or test ran if it did not; correctness-critical work needs real fixtures

codex_on_high_risk.source: Forge default — CLAUDE.md 'Codex (optional reviewer)': available for important changes, read-only, never a blocker

ui_quality_default.source: Forge default — .claude/skills/forge-website/SKILL.md: responsive screenshot loop, no template look, purposeful motion for web and full-stack work

autonomy_default.source: Forge default — .claude/commands/forge.md: autonomy `continue-within-mission` (no phase re-asking); hard gates always interrupt

outreach_draft_only.source: Forge default — .claude/skills/forge-bots/SKILL.md and forge-scraping: outreach is drafted only; nothing is sent without explicit owner approval
